# controld_profile (Data Source)

Fetches a single ControlD profile, identified by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_profile" "home" {
  name = "Home Network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The profile identifier (PK). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the profile. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `updated` (Number) The Unix timestamp of the last update to the profile.
